messages:
Nia (marketing): Need a micro-battlecard + 2-slide webinar hook for next Thurs: focus vs cloud endpoints, LLM APIs, infra vendors. Keep it very short.
Cal (sales): Field pain: surprise bills, p99 spikes, lock-in. Give 1-line rebuttals and a demo CTA.
Ruth (product): Use this structure: claim (1 line), why it matters (1 line), demo hook (1 line). One tech footnote for SREs.
Eli (eng): Bench note: lab dialog runs show ~2x median token cost reduction with prefix KV cache + batching vs a major managed endpoint. p95/p99 vary; label as "internal lab results".
Nia (marketing): Hero options:
 - "Keep your models, stop the surprise bills."
 - "Predictable serving economics, same user experience."
Cal (sales): Rebut snippets:
 - Obj: "We're fine on CloudA."
   Reply: "CloudA is great early; in production teams hit opaque bills and tail latency. Redwood adds routing, caching, and fallbacks so costs and SLOs are predictable."
 - Obj: "Migration is hard."
   Reply: "Start with our API as drop-in and enable routing/caching gradually; Private installs for lift-and-shift."
Ruth (product): SRE footnote: "Continuous batching, per-session KV prefix reuse, and model-variant fallbacks reduce repeated compute while preserving median latency."
Eli (eng): Demo CTA: "See a live routing + fallback demo 94 register for a dedicated capacity slot."
asset-bot: Created asset stub https://internal.redwood/marketing/assets/serve-econ-mini (permissions: marketing-edit).
Nia (marketing): I'll draft the one-pager and short deck callouts; freeze by EOD Monday. Post edits here.
